# The AI Loadout — full directory

Last updated 2026-10-15. Source: https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/

## Coding / Vibe Coding (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/coding/)
1. Cursor (https://cursor.com) — Best all-round AI code editor for shipping real apps fast. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Claude Code (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code) — Best terminal agent for big multi-file changes. Pricing: Paid (Claude plan/API)
3. Muse Wonder (https://dev.meta.ai) — Best Meta frontier model for long coding-agent runs. Pricing: Paid (API + Muse Code)
4. OpenAI Codex (https://openai.com/codex/) — Best for delegating coding tasks to cloud agents. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans
5. GitHub Copilot (https://github.com/features/copilot) — Best inside VS Code and GitHub workflows. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Lovable (https://lovable.dev) — Best for idea-to-full-stack app with zero setup. Pricing: Free tier + paid
7. Bolt.new (https://bolt.new) — Best for instant in-browser prototypes. Pricing: Free tier + paid
8. v0 (https://v0.app) — Best for polished React/Next.js UIs. Pricing: Free tier + paid
9. Replit (https://replit.com) — Best for building and hosting in one place. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## AI Agents (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/agents/)
1. ChatGPT Agent (https://chatgpt.com) — Best general-purpose agent for everyday tasks. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Manus (https://manus.im) — Best for long autonomous research and task runs. Pricing: Free credits + paid
3. n8n (https://n8n.io) — Best for building your own agent workflows (self-hostable). Pricing: Free self-host + paid cloud
4. Zapier Agents (https://zapier.com/agents) — Best for agents that touch 7,000+ apps. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. CrewAI (https://www.crewai.com) — Best framework for multi-agent teams in code. Pricing: Open source + paid cloud
6. LangGraph (https://www.langchain.com/langgraph) — Best for controllable, stateful agent code. Pricing: Open source

## Chat / Assistants (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/chat/)
1. Claude (https://claude.ai) — Best for writing, coding and long documents. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com) — Best default assistant for almost anything. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Grok (https://grok.com) — Best for real-time takes from X. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Gemini (https://gemini.google.com) — Best if you live in Google apps. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Muse Wonder (https://dev.meta.ai) — Best Meta frontier assistant for agentic coding work. Pricing: Paid (API + Muse Code)

## Image (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/image/)
1. Midjourney (https://www.midjourney.com) — Best pure image quality and style. Pricing: Paid
2. ChatGPT Images (https://chatgpt.com) — Best for edits and text in images via chat. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Ideogram (https://ideogram.ai) — Best for logos, posters and typography. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Leonardo.Ai (https://leonardo.ai) — Best for game art and consistent assets. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Adobe Firefly (https://firefly.adobe.com) — Best commercially safe images. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Grok Imagine (https://grok.com/imagine) — Best for fast, playful image and short video generation. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Video (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/video/)
1. Veo (Google Flow) (https://labs.google/flow) — Best realism with native audio. Pricing: Paid (Google AI plans)
2. Sora (https://sora.com) — Best for creative, cinematic clips. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans
3. Runway (https://runwayml.com) — Best pro editing and video tools. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Kling AI (https://klingai.com) — Best motion quality for the price. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. CapCut (https://www.capcut.com) — Best for quick social edits with AI. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Voice / Audio (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/voice/)
1. ElevenLabs (https://elevenlabs.io) — Best voices, cloning and dubbing. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Grok Voice 3.0 (https://x.ai/news/grok-voice-3) — Best speech-to-speech model for real-time voice agents. Pricing: Paid (API)
3. Suno (https://suno.com) — Best for full songs from a prompt. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Udio (https://www.udio.com) — Best for music with fine control. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Descript (https://www.descript.com) — Best for editing podcasts by editing text. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Writing (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/writing/)
1. Claude (https://claude.ai) — Best natural-sounding long-form writing. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Grammarly (https://www.grammarly.com) — Best for polishing everything you type. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Notion AI (https://www.notion.com/product/ai) — Best for writing inside your docs and wiki. Pricing: Paid add-on

## Research / Search (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/research/)
1. Perplexity (https://www.perplexity.ai) — Best answer engine with sources. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. NotebookLM (https://notebooklm.google.com) — Best for studying your own docs (and audio overviews). Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. ChatGPT Deep Research (https://chatgpt.com) — Best for multi-page research reports. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans
4. Elicit (https://elicit.com) — Best for academic papers. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Grok (https://grok.com) — Best for real-time research across X and the web. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Game Dev (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/game-dev/)
1. Rosebud AI (https://rosebud.ai) — Best for vibe coding browser games from prompts. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Scenario (https://www.scenario.com) — Best for on-style game asset generation. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Meshy (https://www.meshy.ai) — Best text/image to 3D models. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Inworld AI (https://inworld.ai) — Best for AI NPC characters and voices. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Tripo (https://www.tripo3d.ai) — Best fast 3D models for prototyping. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Productivity (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/productivity/)
1. Granola (https://www.granola.ai) — Best AI meeting notes without a bot joining. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Gamma (https://gamma.app) — Best for decks and docs in seconds. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Otter.ai (https://otter.ai) — Best for transcripts across meeting apps. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Raycast AI (https://www.raycast.com) — Best AI launcher for Mac power users. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Superhuman (https://superhuman.com) — Best AI email client for speed. Pricing: Paid

## Crypto / Finance AI (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/crypto-finance/)
1. Perplexity Finance (https://www.perplexity.ai/finance) — Best for quick, sourced answers on stocks and markets. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Grok (https://grok.com) — Best for real-time market sentiment from X. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Nansen (https://www.nansen.ai) — Best on-chain wallet and smart-money analytics. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Arkham Intelligence (https://intel.arkm.com) — Best for tracing entities and flows on-chain. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Kaito (https://www.kaito.ai) — Best for crypto narrative and mindshare tracking. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Messari (https://messari.io) — Best crypto research reports with AI summaries. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## 3D (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/3d/)
1. Meshy (https://www.meshy.ai) — Best all-round text/image to 3D. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Tripo (https://www.tripo3d.ai) — Best speed for 3D prototypes. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. Rodin (Hyper3D) (https://hyper3d.ai) — Best for high-detail production-ready 3D. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Spline (https://spline.design) — Best for interactive 3D on the web with AI help. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Blockade Labs Skybox (https://www.blockadelabs.com) — Best for 360° skyboxes and environments. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Kaedim (https://www.kaedim3d.com) — Best for studio-grade game-ready assets. Pricing: Paid

## Music (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/music/)
1. Suno (https://suno.com) — Best for full songs with vocals from a prompt. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Udio (https://www.udio.com) — Best for fine control over music generation. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. ElevenLabs Music (https://elevenlabs.io/music) — Best for commercially cleared AI music. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Stable Audio (https://www.stableaudio.com) — Best for loops, stems and sound design. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. AIVA (https://www.aiva.ai) — Best for orchestral and soundtrack composition. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Mubert (https://mubert.com) — Best royalty-free background music for streams. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Education (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/education/)
1. NotebookLM (https://notebooklm.google.com) — Best for studying your own notes and sources. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Khanmigo (https://www.khanmigo.ai) — Best AI tutor that guides instead of giving answers. Pricing: Free for teachers + paid
3. ChatGPT (https://chatgpt.com) — Best all-purpose explainer and study buddy. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Duolingo (https://www.duolingo.com) — Best for AI-powered language practice. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Quizlet (https://quizlet.com) — Best for AI flashcards and practice tests. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Brisk Teaching (https://www.briskteaching.com) — Best AI toolkit for teachers. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Streamers / Creators (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/creators/)
1. OpusClip (https://www.opus.pro) — Best for turning long videos into viral shorts. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Eklipse (https://eklipse.gg) — Best for auto-clipping Twitch gaming highlights. Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. StreamLadder (https://streamladder.com) — Best for vertical clips from streams. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Captions (https://www.captions.ai) — Best for AI captions, edits and talking videos. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Descript (https://www.descript.com) — Best for editing videos by editing text. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. CapCut (https://www.capcut.com) — Best free all-in-one social editor. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Open-Source & Local Models (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/local-models/)
1. Ollama (https://ollama.com) — Best one-command way to run models locally. Pricing: Free / open source
2. LM Studio (https://lmstudio.ai) — Best desktop app for local models with a GUI. Pricing: Free
3. LFM2.5-24B-A2B (https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-24b-a2b) — Best open MoE for on-device agents (24B total, 2B active). Pricing: Open weights
4. Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co) — Best hub for open models, datasets and demos. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Open WebUI (https://openwebui.com) — Best self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface. Pricing: Free / open source
6. llama.cpp (https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) — Best engine for fast local inference on any hardware. Pricing: Open source
7. Jan (https://www.jan.ai) — Best privacy-first offline assistant. Pricing: Free / open source
8. ComfyUI (https://www.comfy.org) — Best node-based local image/video generation. Pricing: Free / open source

## AI in Games (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/ai-in-games/)
1. Inworld AI (https://inworld.ai) — Best for AI NPC characters and voices. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. NVIDIA ACE (https://developer.nvidia.com/ace) — Best for on-device digital humans in games. Pricing: Free for developers
3. Convai (https://convai.com) — Best for conversational NPCs in Unity/Unreal. Pricing: Free tier + paid
4. Ludo.ai (https://ludo.ai) — Best for game ideation, market research and assets. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Rosebud AI (https://rosebud.ai) — Best for vibe coding playable games from prompts. Pricing: Free tier + paid
